description: This Java source file implements the PaymentService interface, providing methods for processing payments, retrieving payment modules, and handling payment configurations within an e-commerce system framework. It includes logic for payment authorization, capture, refund, validation, and configuration management.

classes.name: PaymentServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the PaymentService interface, managing payment processing, configuration, and validation within the e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Retrieves available payment modules compatible with the merchant store based on region and configuration.

methods.name: getAcceptedPaymentMethods
methods.description: Returns a list of active payment methods with their details, filtered for the merchant store.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByType
methods.description: Fetches a specific payment module based on its type for a given store.

methods.name: getPaymentMethodByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a payment module using its unique code for a specified store.

methods.name: getPaymentConfiguration
methods.description: Obtains the configuration settings for a specific payment module within a store.

methods.name: getPaymentModulesConfigured
methods.description: Loads the payment modules configuration for a merchant store, decrypting stored settings.

methods.name: savePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates and saves the configuration for a given payment module within a store.

methods.name: removePaymentModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Removes a payment module's configuration from a merchant store.

methods.name: processPayment
methods.description: Processes a payment using the specified payment module, handling authorization, capture, and validation.

methods.name: getPaymentModule
methods.description: Returns the PaymentModule instance associated with a given payment module code.

methods.name: processCapturePayment
methods.description: Executes the capture step for a previously authorized transaction associated with an order.

methods.name: processRefund
methods.description: Processes a refund for a specified order, handling partial refunds and transaction validation.

methods.name: validateCreditCard
methods.description: Validates credit card number, expiration date, and type based on standard algorithms.
